text:
Each service can be planned on its own, because there is no limit on concurrent services. This plan misses no (episode, follower) pairs and costs $139.83.

**Tidewell (no paid access)**
- "Distant Garden" can be watched from 11-01 to 11-22.
- "The Velvet Signal" drops 11-04, and the tightest follower window is 7 days, so it must be watched 11-04 to 11-11.
- One period starting **11-04** (access through 12-03) covers both.
- Cost: 1 × $8.99.

**Northline (paid through 11-29)**
- "The Quiet Tide" airs weekly from 12-05 to 02-20. Its only follower is Kofi, who has a 14-day window.
- A period starting **12-19** covers 12-19 to 01-18. That catches the episode of 12-05 on its last allowed day, plus every episode through 01-16.
- A period starting **02-06** covers 02-06 to 03-05. That catches the 01-23 episode on its last allowed day, plus every episode through 02-20.
- Two periods are needed: the episode windows run from 12-05 to 03-06, which is more than two months, so one period cannot cover them.
- Cost: 2 × $11.99.

**Pebble Kids (paid through 11-19)**
- "The Glass Circuit" airs weekly from 01-11 to 03-08. Its only follower is Ivy, who has a 7-day window.
- A period starting **01-18** covers 01-18 to 02-17. That catches the 01-11 episode on its last allowed day, plus every episode through 02-15.
- A period starting **03-01** covers 03-01 to 03-31. That catches the 02-22 episode on its last allowed day, plus the 03-01 and 03-08 episodes.
- Cost: 2 × $7.99.

**Lumen (paid through 11-03)**
- Four shows release here: "The Copper Tide", "The Copper Ferry", "The Hollow Atlas" and "The Glass Ferry". Every one has a 7-day follower, so each episode must be caught within 7 days of release.
- Releases run from 11-21 to 03-30.
- Each period starts on the last allowed day of the earliest episode not yet covered:
  - **11-28**: covers 11-28 to 12-27, so episodes released 11-21 through 12-26.
  - **01-07**: covers 01-07 to 02-06, so episodes released 12-31 through 02-04.
  - **02-16**: covers 02-16 to 03-15, so episodes released 02-09 through 03-09.
  - **03-23**: covers 03-23 to 04-22, so episodes released 03-16 through 03-30.
- Starting each period as late as possible is the standard approach that uses the fewest periods, so three would not be enough.
- Cost: 4 × $15.49.

All periods start within the plan dates, and no service has overlapping access.
